title: Multi-Noise2Noise: Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Denoising for Cryo-Electron Microscopy (code)
description:
Code of Multi-Noise2Noise: Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Denoising for Cryo-Electron Microscopy (Grzesiuk, Karanowski, Kuczbański, Rzepiela, Frey, Zięba; Bioinformatics, submitted).

Multi-Noise2Noise trains a U-Net on dose-fractionated particle movies: the average of all but one frame is the input and the held-out frame the target, optionally with CTF- and dose-weighted Fourier losses. The repository contains training, denoising, 3D reconstruction of the denoised particles, the evaluation behind every reported number and the motion-correction and extraction pipelines used to prepare the particle movies.

Data, partitions, masks, reference maps, checkpoints and reconstructions are in the cryo_datasets repository (DVC).
